fields.label: Business Registration No. (BRS)
fields.description: Certificate of incorporation/registration as registered with the Business Registration Service. Verified against BRS by E-GP in real time.

fields.label: KRA PIN
fields.description: Tax Identification Number verified against iTax.

fields.label: Business Email
fields.description: E-GP requires a private-domain business email (public domains are rejected).

fields.label: County
fields.description: County where the business operates (of the 47 counties).

fields.label: Authorised Representative
fields.description: Owner / director / authorised person who manages the E-GP account.

fields.label: Authorised Rep National ID
fields.description: National ID of the authorised representative (verified against IPRS).

fields.label: Business Categories
fields.description: Procurement categories you are registered in - procuring entities search by these.

fields.label: AGPO Eligible
fields.description: Eligible for the 30% government set-aside programme (Access to Government Procurement Opportunities).

fields.label: AGPO Category
fields.options:
Youth Enterprise
Women Enterprise
Persons with Disability Enterprise

fields.label: E-GP Status
fields.options:
Not Registered
Pending Verification
Registered
Suspended

fields.label: Onboarding Date
fields.description: Date the supplier was onboarded on the E-GP portal.
